Ghal Bol: realtime, private, peer-to-peer messaging and calls

The shipping product under the Ghal Bol brand — peer-to-peer encrypted text, delivery and read receipts, and native voice/video calls between online peers. The public app name is Ghal Bol (com.ghalbol).
Messages are sealed on your device. The delivery mailbox holds only opaque ciphertext until the recipient acknowledges it.
Calls connect peer-to-peer on LAN when possible, otherwise through a lightweight coord bridge that never decrypts media.
Each install creates a local cryptographic identity. Invite with QR or link — no phone number or social login.
Guest scans the host QR (or opens an invite link). The guest stores the host public key and dials. Mutual QR is never required.
Share your https://ghalbol.com/connect/… link or QR from Invite in Ghal Bol.
They open it in Ghal Bol (or install from Play / Linux first).
When both are reachable, chat and calls connect — LAN and WAN paths run in parallel for calls.
Windows packages are built from the same workspace. The public download on this site is the Linux desktop bundle; Android ships on Google Play as com.ghalbol.
Install Ghal Bol from Play. Verified App Links open invites straight into the app when possible.
Extract the release archive, then ./install.sh (per-user) or ./run.sh to try in place.

Gotigin is the trademark (Where Technology Meets Discovery). GOTIGIN SOFTWARE & HARDWARE PRIVATE LIMITED is the company. Ghal Bol is the brand for communication products; this site is ghalbol.com. The messenger is what ships today. Package names and the domain stay ghalbol — one word. There is no separate camel-case brand.
x86_64 production bundle. Extract the archive, then run ./install.sh (per-user into ~/.local) or ./run.sh to try it in place.
